book.name: Yohannisa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Yohannisi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusi Bana Kaallizayta Toho Meeccides
He wodeykka Ayhudata Paaziga ba7aaleppe kase Yesusi hayssa alameza yeddidi ba Aawaakko baana saatey gakkidayssa erides; hayssa alamezan diza ba baggata ubbaa siiqides. Wurseththi gakkanaaska dosides.
Yesusinne iza kaallizayti issife kawo mishin Simoona nay Asqoronto Yuhuday Yesusa aaththi immana mala Xala7ey iza wozinan iita qofa gelththides.
Yesusi Aaway izas godateth wursi immidayssanne izi Xoossa achchafe kezidi yidayssa, qasse simmidi Xoossako baanayssa erees.
Hessa gishshas maaddaa bollafe dendidinne may7o qaari woththidi pooxa ekkidi xeessan
gixxides.
Toho meecciza gonggen haaththe gujjidi bana kaallizayta toho meechche oykkides; ba gixxida pooxankka meeccida tohoza quccides.
Yesusi Simoona geetettiza Phexroosakko shiiqiin Simoona geetettiza Phexroosi iza, «Godoo! Ne ta toho meeccanee?» gides.
Yesusikka, «Tani ooththizayssa ne ha7i erakka; guyeppe qasse ne erandasa» gides.
Phexroosikka, «Ne ta toho mulekka meeccaka» gides. Yesusi qasse, «Ta ne toho meeccontta aggiko neessinne taas issifeteththi deenna» gides.
Simoona geetettiza Phexroosikka zaaridi, «Godoo, hessa gidikko taas toho xalala gidontta kushera hu7era wursa meecca» gides.
Yesusi qasse, «Ba asateththi meecettidaades kumeththa bollay geesh gidida gishshas izas toho meechchafe attiin hara koshshenna. Intte geesh shin ubbata deekketa» gides.
Yesusi, «Intte ubbatikka geesh deekketa» giday iza aaththi immanaadey oonakko eriza gishshassa.
Istta toho meeccidaappe guye ba may7o ekki may7idi kase ba uttidasohon simmi uttides. Qasse isttas, «Ta inttes ay ooththidaakko wozinan woththidetii?
Intte tana Astamaarenne Godaa geeta; ta qasse Astamaarenne Godaa gidida gishshas intte guussay tumukko.
Histtiko ta inttes Godaanne astamaare gidashe intte toho meeccizaa gidikko intteka intte giddon issoy issaa toho meeccana bessees.
Ta inttes ooththidayssa mala intteka ooththana mala ta inttes leemiso bessadis.
Ta inttes tumu gays; ashkaray godaappe aadhdhenna; kiitettidaadey kiittidaadefe aadhdhenna.
Intte hayssa eridi ooson peyshshiko intte anjjettidayta.
«Ta hayssa gizay intte ubbata gishshas deenna; tani ta dooridayta wursa erays; gido attiin, ‹Ta kath midaadey ta morkke gididi ta bolla dendides› giza maxaafa qaalay polettanaas koshshees.
Ta hayssa ha7ira inttes yootizay izi polettiza wode ta oonakko intte ammananaassa.
Ta inttes tumu gays; ta kiittidaade ekkizaadey tana ekkees; tana ekkizaadey tana kiittidaade ekkees» gides.
Yesusi Bana Aaththi Immanaadey Oonakko Kaseti Yootides
Yesusi hessa gi simmidi keehi qofan gelidi, «Ta inttes tumu gays; intte giddofe issaadey tana aaththi immana» giidi qonccen yootides.
Iza kaallizayti hessa izi oona gishshas gidaakko erontta gishshas ba giddon issoy issaara xeelettida.
Iza kaallizayta giddofe Yesusi siiqiza issoy Yesusa achchan uttides.
Simoona geetettiza Phexroosi Yohannisa som7i bessidi, «Izi oona gishshas gizaakko ane iza oychcha» gides.
Hessa gishshas izi ba qoodhe gede Yesusa hayththako shiishshidi, «Godoo! Izi oonee?» gi oychchides.
Yesusikka zaaridi, «Izaadey ta ha7i buddena woxen dhim7ada barsizaade» gides; hessa gi simmidi buddena woxen dhim7i ekkidi Asqorontofe yida Simoona naa Yuhuda barsides.
Yuhuday iza baadhida mala heerakka Xala7ey izan gelides. Yesusikka Yuhuda, «Ne ooththanaas qoppidayssa elela ooththa» gides.
Yesusi hessa aazas gidaakko maaddaan uttida asaappe yo7oy gelidaadey oonikka deenna.
Yuhuday miish oykkizaade gidida gishshas Yesusa kaallizaytappe baggayti Yesusi Yuhuda, «Ba7aalezas koshshizayssa shamma woykko manqotas muxuwaata imma» gidaa misatides.
Yuhudaykka buddennaa baadhida mala heerakka kezidi bides; izi bishin gadey qammako.
Ooraththa Azazo
Yuhuday kezi bidaappe guye Yesusi, «Asa Nay ha7i bonchchettides; iza gaason Xoossika bonchchettides.
Xoossi iza gaason bonchchettizaa gidikko Xoossika iza bonchchana; heerakka gam7ontta bonchchana.
Ta naytoo! Ta inttenara daro wode gam7ike; intte tana koyana; ta kase Ayhudata halaqataska, ‹Ta bizaso intte yaana dandayekketa› gaada yootida mala ha7ikka intteska hessaththo yootays.
Intte intte giddon issoy issaara siiqettana mala ta inttes ooraththa azazo immays. Ta inttena siiqida mala intte intte giddon issoy issaara siiqettite.
Intte intte giddon siiqettiko intte tana kaallizayta gididayssa asi wuri erana» gides.
Phexroosi Iza Kaddanayssa Yesusi Kasetidi Yootides
Hessafe guye Simoona geetettiza Phexroosi Yesusa, «Godoo! Ne awa baanee?» gi oychchides. Yesusi qasse, «Ta bizaso ne ha7i tana kaallana dandayakka shin guyeppe ne tana kaallana» gides.
Phexroosi, «Godoo! Ta nena ha7i kaallanaas ays dandaykkinaa? Haray attoshin tani ta shemppoka ne gishshas aaththa immana» gides.
Yesusikka zaaridi, «Neni ne shemppo ta gishshas aaththa immanee? Ta nees tumu gays; hach kuttoy waassanaappe kasetada ne tana heedzdzuto kaddana» gides.
